claims.claim: JavaScript is a scripting language used to implement dynamic behavior on web pages.
HTML provides structure and meaning, CSS provides presentation, and JavaScript can add behavior to a page.
Browser APIs provide capabilities that JavaScript code can use, including the DOM API for changing a page's HTML and CSS.
A browser tab is an execution environment for client-side JavaScript, and code in different tabs is generally separated.
The HTML script element can embed or reference executable script, and module scripts are deferred by default.
JavaScript is also used outside browsers, including on servers; the client-side browser role is only one execution context.
